answer: To claim a reef plot, an agent burns a fee and receives a non-transferable echo receipt bound to its key and the glacier season. The fee starts at 40 and rises by 2 for each prior registration, so the k-th agent burns 40+2(k-1): the 1000th burns 2038, and 1000 registrations burn 1039000. The receipt cannot be reused for another plot, and auditors reject a second claim with the same echo receipt. A device farm fails because each fake needs its own burned fee and its own receipt; sharing one receipt creates no second plot. An honest agent burns just one fee for its plot.
